title: pinus wallichiana subsp. bhutanica
intro: Pinus wallichiana subsp. bhutanica, commonly known as Bhutan white pine, is a subspecies of evergreen tree in the pine family native to the Himalayas. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bhutan white pine include anti-arthritic, anti-ulcer, and immunomodulatory effects, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with arthritis, ulcers, and immune system disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
